description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of four different sampling strategies—Greedy and RPG—across three distinct metrics: EGP, TR-N, and CCP. The vertical axis, labeled "Performance," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale, representing normalized scores. The horizontal axis, labeled "Metrics," displays the three evaluation criteria, each marked with an upward arrow (↑) for metrics where higher values indicate better performance and a downward arrow (↓) for metrics where lower values are preferred. The chart uses grouped bars for each metric, with each group containing four bars corresponding to the sampling methods: Greedy (CodeLlama-7B, blue), RPG (CodeLlama-7B, orange), Greedy (CodeLlama-34B, green), and RPG (CodeLlama-34B, brown). For the EGP metric, the performance values are approximately 0.0 (blue), 0.9 (orange), 0.6 (green), and 1.0 (brown). For the TR-N metric, the values are approximately 0.7 (blue), 0.45 (orange), 0.6 (green), and 0.4 (brown). For the CCP metric, the values are approximately 0.4 (blue), 0.7 (orange), 0.7 (green), and 0.95 (brown). The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the metrics. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding according to the legend.
